files.role: Public in-memory attempt preparation containers and accessors, reexported by transaction. Preparation algorithm resides in manifest_build, not this module.
ranges: SPDX/docs distinguish original index list (for MemWAL comparison) from prepared list with invalidated coverage removed/pruned before manifest assembly. Docs say recreate per attempt from current manifest, keeping original unmodified and copying no files. Imports IndexMetadata, TaggedRewriteAssembly and Arc. These are documented lifecycle responsibilities, not actions in these declarations.

FragReuseUpdate derives Debug/Clone/Default and is non_exhaustive. None is default, Rewrite owns Arc<TaggedRewriteAssembly>, Trim has no payload. Docs say unprepared tagged Rewrite/CreateIndex shapes are refused to avoid discarding concurrent history; Rewrite is assembled for current head, Trim derives from cleanup. Enum construction performs no enforcement; external matching needs a wildcard. Arc Clone shares assembly.

PreparedIndices derives Debug/Clone and privately owns manifest_version:Option<u64>, original/prepared Vec<IndexMetadata>, frag_reuse:FragReuseUpdate. Docs promise preparation gates and stale-attempt rejection elsewhere. Private fields prevent external direct construction, but crate-visible new accepts unchecked inputs; no manifest identity/hash binding beyond optional numeric version. Clone duplicates Vec/metadata values and uses contained clone semantics.

pub(crate) new takes all four values by ownership and simply stores them. No gate, list relation, timestamp or version check. The fully analyzed local producer Transaction::prepare_indices first performs gate/classification and optional lineage withdrawal (rust/lance-table/src/transaction/manifest_build.rs:474-522). Complete Dataset attempt orchestration remains pending.

Public manifest_version returns copied Option<u64>, with None documented for creation. original returns immutable borrowed slice without cloning or mutation. Caller cannot replace private Vec via this method.
Public prepared returns immutable borrowed prepared slice; frag_reuse_update borrows the stored enum. Neither computes preparation, compares versions nor performs IO.

pub(crate) into_parts consumes wrapper, returning owned (original,prepared,frag_reuse), dropping manifest_version from returned data. The analyzed builder checks the attempt version and repeats the gate before consumption (rust/lance-table/src/transaction/manifest_build.rs:593-611). No tests, async, locking or unsafe in this file.
